about.en: Hooked is a Solana launchpad for tokens that carry their own rules: each token uses a Token-2022 transfer hook that Solana runs on every transfer, enforcing holder caps, vesting, dividends or royalties at the protocol level instead of in a separate contract. HOOKED is the platform's token, at C1mBfBoDkwWfd6uTFZp62ARHLjeVp3bDpCDMfMZtPngE on Solana.
